name: @aws-token-designer/api
description: api Lambda: Hono router for profile, sheets, and images

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:api: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:sharp '--banner:js=import{createRequire as __createRequire} from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --sourcemap
scripts.build:worker: esbuild src/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/worker.mjs --external:sharp '--banner:js=import{createRequire as __createRequire} from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --sourcemap
